n, k = map(int, input().split())
p = list(map(float, input().split()))

result = [0.0] * n
probability = [0.0] * (1 << n)
bits_count = [0] * (1 << n)

for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
    bits_count[mask] = bin(mask).count('1')

probability[0] = 1.0

for mask in range(1 << n):
    total_p = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if (mask & (1 << i)) == 0:
            total_p += p[i]
    if total_p < 1e-12:
        continue
    for i in range(n):
        if (mask & (1 << i)) == 0:
            p_i = p[i] / total_p
            if bits_count[mask] < k:
                result[i] += probability[mask] * p_i
            probability[mask | (1 << i)] += probability[mask] * p_i

print(' '.join(f"{x:.12f}" for x in result))
